content_summary: A static graphic displaying a speaker icon and clapping hands plays a continuous sound effect of rapid applause.
narrative_skeleton: Static graphic presentation of an isolated audio meme template with no visual progression or narrative arc.

narrative_transferability.reasoning: Lacks any narrative structure; it is purely an isolated audio effect template.

hook_strength.reasoning: A static icon paired with clapping sound effects provides minimal visual scroll-stopping engagement.

production_feasibility.reasoning: Requires only basic static graphics and a stock audio clip.

brand_fit.reasoning: Chaotic, repetitive applause clashes directly with the calm, artisanal aesthetic of the brand.

licensing_safety.reasoning: Sound effect appears generic, though app branding graphics are present.
